notes.key_*: A column is id-like when it has at least key_min_mentions mentions, distinct values / mentions >= key_distinct_share, and its value type is not time, day, date, duration, price, decimal or boolean. Set once on dev50 from the distinct-share list of the Step 3 columns (input a): ordinary columns reach at most 0.89, reference numbers and phone numbers 0.93 and up; 0.9 sits in that gap. Not tuned on scores.
notes.link_*: Code proposes a link between two tables when they hold two id-like columns (one in each) with the same normalised name, or with at least link_min_shared_values shared distinct values making up at least link_overlap_share of the smaller value set. Same data, same single setting, no score used.
notes.vote_table_jaccard: A table of seed k is matched to a table of the first finished seed when the names are equal, else when the column sets have Jaccard >= this value (one to one, best first); an unmatched table stays a table of its own.
